open_points.subject: staff credential ownership and distribution
open_points.text: “staff hold a staff credential”; “It acts for the owner and holds the staff credential”; “that server ... holds the staff credential”; “the configuration of the one holder it is for”
open_points.question: Is there one shared staff credential copied to multiple staff clients, or a separate staff credential for each holder?
options: One shared staff credential held by staff, the operator and frontend servers
A distinct staff credential for each holder
Exactly one staff-credential holder per Registry instance
open_points.default_guess: One shared staff credential copied to every authorized staff client.

open_points.subject: Registry frontend credential trust boundary
open_points.text: “How the frontend obtains the staff credential belongs to the frontend.”
open_points.question: For the frontend that calls Registry directly from a browser on Registry's host, does the staff credential enter the browser, get entered for each session, or remain in a trusted server that mediates staff requests?
options: The credential is stored or otherwise made available in the browser
The user enters the credential for a browser session
A trusted frontend server retains the credential and mediates requests
open_points.default_guess: The user enters the staff credential for the browser session, and it is not persistently stored.
